title: Is A subset of B
description:
Given the sets `A = {19, 22, 24, 20, 25, 26}` and `B = {19, 22, 20, 25, 26, 24, 28, 27}`: Is A subset of B?

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as `is_subset(a, b)`, returning True if every element of `a` is also in `b`, False otherwise.
hints: A set is a subset of another when every one of its elements also belongs to the other set.
Sets have a dedicated method that answers exactly this question with True or False.
Call a.issubset(b) and return its result directly.
expected_behavior: Returns True if every element of a is contained in b, False otherwise.

hidden_tests.label: A is a subset of B
B is not a subset of A
a set is a subset of itself

explanation: set.issubset() returns True exactly when every element of the calling set is also present in the other set, which is the definition of a subset relationship.
